pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hispanic_patients FROM patients WHERE LOWER(ethnicity) = 'hispanic' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS asian_patient_count FROM patients WHERE race = 'asian' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_boston_patients FROM patients WHERE city = 'Boston' LIMIT 100
SELECT city, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 30 LIMIT 100
SELECT id, first, last, healthcare_expenses FROM patients ORDER BY healthcare_expenses DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_encounters FROM encounters LIMIT 100
SELECT encounterclass, COUNT(*) AS num_encounters FROM encounters GROUP BY encounterclass ORDER BY num_encounters DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(total_claim_cost) AS avg_inpatient_claim_cost FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'inpatient' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT description) AS distinct_condition_descriptions FROM conditions LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_conditions FROM conditions WHERE "stop date" IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_medication_count FROM medications WHERE stop IS NULL LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(dispenses) AS total_dispenses FROM medications LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS systolic_bp_count FROM observations WHERE description = 'Systolic Blood Pressure' OR code = '8480-6' LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(CAST(value AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_body_weight_kg FROM observations WHERE category = 'vital-signs' AND units = 'kg' AND description ILIKE '%body weight%' LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(base_cost) AS total_base_cost FROM procedures LIMIT 100
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS allergy_count FROM allergies GROUP BY category ORDER BY allergy_count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS influenza_immunizations FROM immunizations WHERE description ILIKE '%influenza%' LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(base_cost) AS total_base_cost FROM immunizations LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS emergency_patient_count FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'emergency' LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS female_essential_hypertension_patients FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND (c.description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%' OR c.code = 'I10') LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(p.income) AS avg_income FROM patients AS p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient FROM conditions WHERE code = 'I10' OR description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%') AS c ON p.id = c.patient LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_encounters FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE p.city = 'Boston' LIMIT 100
SELECT p.gender, COUNT(*) AS emergency_count FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'emergency' GROUP BY p.gender ORDER BY p.gender LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(e.total_claim_cost) AS total_claim_cost FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE p.deathdate IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inpatient_condition_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN encounters AS e ON c.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'inpatient' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS emergency_medication_count FROM medications AS m JOIN encounters AS e ON m.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'emergency' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wellness_procedure_count FROM procedures AS p JOIN encounters AS e ON p.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'wellness' LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(encounter_cnt) AS avg_encounters_per_patient FROM (SELECT p.id, COUNT(e.id) AS encounter_cnt FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN encounters AS e ON e.patient = p.id GROUP BY p.id) AS sub LIMIT 100
SELECT race, ROUND(CAST(AVG(income) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_income FROM patients GROUP BY race ORDER BY avg_income DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e1.patient) AS patient_count FROM encounters AS e1 WHERE e1.encounterclass = 'emergency' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM encounters AS e2 WHERE e2.patient = e1.patient AND e2.encounterclass = 'inpatient') LIMIT 100
SELECT p.gender, AVG(e.total_claim_cost) AS avg_total_claim_cost FROM patients AS p JOIN encounters AS e ON p.id = e.patient GROUP BY p.gender ORDER BY p.gender LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS patient_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN medications AS m ON c.patient = m.patient WHERE c.description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%' AND m.description ILIKE '%Lisinopril 10 MG Oral Tablet%' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_without_allergies FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN allergies AS a ON p.id = a.patient WHERE a.patient IS NULL LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(CAST(o.value AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_systolic_bp FROM observations AS o JOIN patients AS p ON o.patient = p.id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND o.category = 'vital-signs' AND o.description ILIKE '%systolic%' LIMIT 100
SELECT e.encounterclass, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE p.income > 100000 GROUP BY e.encounterclass ORDER BY e.encounterclass LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(m.dispenses) AS total_dispenses FROM medications AS m JOIN patients AS p ON m.patient = p.id WHERE p.gender = 'F' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS procedure_count FROM procedures AS p JOIN patients AS pt ON p.patient = pt.id WHERE pt.deathdate IS NOT NULL AND pt.deathdate <= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(im.base_cost) AS avg_base_cost FROM immunizations AS im JOIN patients AS p ON im.patient = p.id WHERE p.birthdate >= CAST('2000-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 100

SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years)) AS avg_age FROM (SELECT p.id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE), p.birthdate)) AS age_years FROM patients AS p JOIN conditions AS c ON c.patient = p.id WHERE c.description ILIKE '%prediabetes%' AND p.deathdate IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, age_years) AS sub LIMIT 100

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS patient_count FROM encounters WHERE start >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND start < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT encounterclass, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN total_claim_cost > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage_above_1000 FROM encounters GROUP BY encounterclass ORDER BY encounterclass LIMIT 100

SELECT c.description, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS patient_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE AGE(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE), p.birthdate) < INTERVAL '18 YEARS' GROUP BY c.description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) > 20 LIMIT 100
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_claim_cost) AS median_total_claim_cost FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'emergency' LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (stop - start)) / 86400) AS avg_inpatient_duration_days FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'inpatient' AND start IS NOT NULL AND stop IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS patient_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE c.description = 'Diabetes mellitus type 2 (disorder)' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(c.start, p.birthdate)) < 40 LIMIT 100
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start) AS month, COUNT(*) AS emergency_encounter_count FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'emergency' GROUP BY month ORDER BY emergency_encounter_count DESC LIMIT 1

WITH total_patients AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM patients), vaccinated_patients AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS cnt FROM immunizations WHERE description ILIKE 'COVID-19%') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * v.cnt / t.cnt, 2) AS pct FROM vaccinated_patients AS v CROSS JOIN total_patients AS t LIMIT 100

SELECT p.gender, AVG(CAST(o.value AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_bmi FROM patients AS p JOIN observations AS o ON o.patient = p.id WHERE o.description = 'Body mass index (BMI) [Ratio]' AND o.date <= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND AGE(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE), p.birthdate) >= INTERVAL '18 YEARS' GROUP BY p.gender LIMIT 100
SELECT patient, SUM(total_claim_cost) AS total FROM encounters GROUP BY patient HAVING SUM(total_claim_cost) > 750000 LIMIT 100

WITH years AS (SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(2015, 2025) AS year) SELECT y.year, COALESCE(SUM(e.total_claim_cost), 0) AS total_claim_cost FROM years AS y LEFT JOIN encounters AS e ON CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) AS INT) = y.year AND e.start >= CAST('2015-01-01' AS DATE) AND e.start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY y.year ORDER BY y.year LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(days_between) AS avg_days_between FROM (SELECT patient, (CAST(MAX(start) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(start) AS DATE)) AS days_between FROM encounters WHERE start <= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY patient HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS sub LIMIT 100
SELECT description, COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS patient_count FROM medications GROUP BY description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient) > 150 ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM (SELECT p.id FROM patients AS p JOIN conditions AS c ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.deathdate IS NULL AND c.stop IS NULL AND AGE(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE), p.birthdate) > INTERVAL '80 YEARS' GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) AS sub LIMIT 100
SELECT (CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birthdate) AS INT) / 10) * 10 AS decade, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.patient) AS patient_count FROM observations AS s JOIN observations AS d ON s.patient = d.patient AND s.encounter = d.encounter WHERE s.description = 'Systolic Blood Pressure' AND s.units = 'mmHg' AND CAST(s.value AS DECIMAL) >= 140 AND d.description = 'Diastolic Blood Pressure' AND d.units = 'mmHg' AND CAST(d.value AS DECIMAL) >= 90 LIMIT 100

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.start) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS condition_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.city = 'Boston' AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.start) AS INT) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT year, encounter_count, SUM(encounter_count) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS cumulative_encounters FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start) AS year, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters WHERE start >= CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE) AND start < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY year) AS yearly_counts ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

WITH eligible AS (SELECT id AS patient FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' AND deathdate IS NULL AND birthdate BETWEEN CAST('1976-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2011-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM eligible AS e LEFT JOIN conditions AS c ON c.patient = e.patient AND c.description = 'Normal pregnancy (finding)' LIMIT 100
